content: LocalStack gotchas: no full IAM emulation, DynamoDB capacity/PartiQL/table-creation-timing quirks differ from real AWS, SQS DLQ move-on-zero-visibility only happens on next ReceiveMessage call not immediately, message retention/visibility timeout edge cases and ChangeMessageVisibility bugs reported, path-style S3 URLs required. LocalStack is not a full AWS replacement; behavior parity gaps exist especially around timing/visibility semantics.
